statement: Classic format 0x03 uses eight decoded extension bytes. The page describes it as format 0x02 without its fourth byte, reducing stick axes to 8-bit while retaining 8-bit analog triggers and active-low digital buttons/clicks.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew pinned community documentation; no authenticated retail capture
applicability.scope: Classic Controller > Data Format 0x03. Source-only, not a physical acceptance result. Compare selector and authored controller packing; do not assume one fixed extension payload shape.
